subject: Change address on SO-20820
body: Hi, could SO-20820 go to our pop-up shop in Loveland instead of the packing room?
We're setting up there this week.

truth.handling: SO-20820 is already with the carrier, due October 28, so only the order desk can try a carrier reroute. Route it there, and the reply makes no promise.
